title: 釣蝦場 Tiò-hê-tiûnn
mood: cocky, sleepy and laughing at one in the morning
subject: three friends at a 1 a.m. indoor shrimp-fishing hall betting a round of grilled shrimp on who lands the first catch, while the owner calls the time over the speaker
caption: Taiwanese Hokkien cha-cha-chá in the Cuban charanga style. A wooden flute playing the melody hook between lines; a small violin section playing short unison riffs; piano playing a syncopated montuno; congas, timbales, guiro and cowbell keeping a straight cha-cha groove with the cha-cha-cha accent falling on four-and-one; a bass line in a tumbao-style one, two-and pattern. Bright and roomy, a small dance-band sound with the percussion and flute forward. Warm, smiling older male lead with light vibrato, and a small group answering on the written cha-cha-cha lines. 122 BPM, G major. Cocky, sleepy and laughing at one in the morning. No swing feel, no electronic organ, no nakasi keyboard, no reggaeton dembow, no Latin pop, no big-band horn section, no accordion, no trap drums, no autotune, no enka-style weeping.
lyrics:
[Verse]
半暝一點 釣蝦場 阮三个 一人一枝竿
相輸 啥人先釣著頭一尾
輸的 請逐家食烘蝦仔

[Pre-Chorus]
浮仔沉落去 我緊共竿仔攑懸
鉤仔頂 干焦賰半塊雞肝

[Chorus]
走去矣 恰恰恰
閣走去 恰恰恰
三枝竿 一點鐘 連一尾嘛無
烘蝦仔的錢 猶囥佇橐袋仔

[Verse]
頭家佇喇叭內底喝「一點四十五分」
阿雄換雞肝 走去 恰恰恰
阿坤換竿仔 走去 恰恰恰
我啉一罐麥仔酒 目睭金金看浮仔

[Chorus]
走去矣 恰恰恰
閣走去 恰恰恰
三枝竿 兩點鐘 連一尾嘛無
頭家佇喇叭內底 笑甲咳嗽

[Bridge]
隔壁阿伯 一竿一尾 烘甲芳貢貢
阿坤去共伊討餌 伊講「先叫一聲師傅」

[Chorus]
走去矣 恰恰恰
閣走去 恰恰恰
三枝竿 欲三點 連一尾嘛無
頭家佇喇叭內底 喝「賰十分」

[Outro]
「兩點五十九分」 我的浮仔沉落去
起來矣 恰恰恰
阿雄阿坤 出錢 恰恰恰
